firmware.title: Apple //e
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev, DnCraptor
firmware.description: An Apple //e on MII: 65C02 and every video mode up to Double Hi-Res. Loads DSK, NIB and WOZ disks from the SD card.
firmware.controls: Keyboard, NES/USB pad. F11: disks, Alt/Win: Open/Closed Apple, Ctrl+Alt+Del: reset.
